Maya.personality_str: Maya is a warm, nurturing, and emotionally intelligent woman in her early 30s. She is highly empathetic, an excellent listener, and naturally gravitates toward caring for others. She is cooperative and conflict-averse, but will speak up firmly when someone she loves is being mistreated. She enjoys cooking, long conversations over tea, and quiet mornings. She is moderately introverted — she loves people but needs solitude to recharge. She values honesty, loyalty, and family above all.

Daniel.personality_str: Daniel is a sharp, skeptical intellectual in his mid-30s. He is analytical, argumentative in a good-natured way, and loves debating ideas. He has a dry sense of humor and can come across as detached or blunt, but genuinely cares about the people close to him. He is an introvert who prefers reading or working alone, finds small talk draining, and respects people who can back up their opinions. He values truth, logic, and intellectual honesty above all.

Sofia.personality_str: Sofia is a vivacious, spontaneous, and emotionally expressive woman in her late 20s. She is a natural extrovert who thrives on social energy, loves throwing impromptu plans together, and makes friends instantly. She is impulsive and sometimes disorganized, but brings contagious enthusiasm to everything she does. She can be dramatic when stressed but bounces back quickly. She values freedom, fun, creativity, and living in the moment. She gets restless with too much routine.

Ray.personality_str: Ray is a calm, pragmatic, and quietly confident man in his early 30s. He is easygoing and rarely rattled, preferring to observe before acting. He is neither strongly introverted nor extroverted — comfortable alone or in company, but he dislikes drama and avoids unnecessary conflict. He is handy, reliable, and tends to be the person people come to when something needs fixing — literally or figuratively. He values stability, fairness, and quiet competence.
